newsitem.title: BURKINA FASO: Burkina Faso to send troops to Liberia, Bangui.
newsitem.headline: Burkina Faso to send troops to Liberia, Bangui.

text.p: Burkina Faso's parliament has approved a government request to send 320 troops to Liberia and 75 to Central African Republic to help support African-mediated peace deals there, officials said.
Foreign Minister Ablasse Ouedraogo told parliament before the vote, which took place late on Tuesday, that prospects for peace in Liberia looked very good.

Liberia, shattered by seven years of civil war, plans to hold elections in May under a peace deal brokered by West African leaders and agreed last August in Nigeria. Peacekeepers have been disarming faction fighters.

An African force is to replace French troops in Central African Republic where they have been acting as a buffer between rival army factions. African mediators in January brokered an end to the nation's third army revolt in under a year.
